title: RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata
description: Project-derived validation schema encoding RFC 8414 Section 2 plus RFC 9126 and RFC 9449 metadata extensions. This schema is not published by the RFC authors.

issuer.description: The authorization server's issuer identifier URL.

authorization_endpoint.description: URL of the authorization server's authorization endpoint.

token_endpoint.description: URL of the authorization server's token endpoint.

pushed_authorization_request_endpoint.description: URL of the authorization server's pushed authorization request (PAR) endpoint.

require_pushed_authorization_requests.description: Indicates whether the authorization server requires PAR for authorization requests.

dpop_signing_alg_values_supported.description: List of the DPoP signing algorithms supported by the authorization server.

code_challenge_methods_supported.description: List of PKCE code challenge methods supported by the authorization server.

response_types_supported.description: List of OAuth 2.0 response_type values supported.

response_modes_supported.description: List of OAuth 2.0 response_mode values supported.

grant_types_supported.description: List of OAuth 2.0 grant_type values supported.

token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported.description: List of client authentication methods supported by the token endpoint.

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description: List of signing algorithms supported for client authentication.

scopes_supported.description: List of OAuth 2.0 scope values supported.

authorization_response_iss_parameter_sup.description: Indicates whether the authorization response includes the iss parameter.

jwks_uri.description: URL of the authorization server's JSON Web Key Set document.

registration_endpoint.description: URL of the authorization server's dynamic client registration endpoint.

revocation_endpoint.description: URL of the authorization server's token revocation endpoint.

revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_support.description: List of client authentication methods supported by the revocation endpoint.

introspection_endpoint.description: URL of the authorization server's token introspection endpoint.

introspection_endpoint_auth_methods_supp.description: List of client authentication methods supported by the introspection endpoint.

service_documentation.description: URL of the authorization server's documentation.

client_id_metadata_document_supported.description: Indicates whether the authorization server supports client ID metadata documents.
